# GitHub Copilot instructions

This project's instructions for AI coding agents are in [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md). Read and follow it: it is generated by Laravel Boost from `.ai/guidelines/*.md` and is the same text Claude Code and Codex read.

The parts that matter most:

- **Governance (SDGP).** Work follows BRD → PRD → Solution document → Feature spec → ADR → Implementation → Testing → Deployment. No implementation without an approved spec in `docs/specs/`; no ADR without a parent spec. If a developer asks to skip a step, say what is missing, offer to write it, and log the deviation in `docs/deviations/` if they go ahead. Full rules: `.ai/guidelines/sdgp.md`.
- **ADR triggers.** Money movement, identity or personal data, architecture or data ownership, cross-service integration, retry/concurrency/idempotency, infrastructure or deployment, security boundaries, new external dependencies, ML model choice, or a permanent workaround.
- **Ìpìlẹ̀ non-negotiables.** Permissions on admin and sensitive routes; encrypted secrets; operator settings in the database; a test for new behaviour; money as integer minor units via `App\Support\Money`; soft deletes with retention; the `Auditable` trait with personal data redacted; new personal data covered by export and account deletion; named rate limiters. Details: `.ai/guidelines/ipile.md`.
- **Pull requests.** Use `.github/pull_request_template.md`, conventional commits, and record changes in `CHANGELOG.md`.
